blinding_note: Label-hidden review: dataset, condition, model and repetition are withheld and the order is shuffled, but paper content may reveal its condition (e.g. by discussing supplied tables). Mapping is stored separately.
id_generation: secrets.token_hex; order shuffled with SystemRandom; reproducible only via the saved mapping file
selection: only successful records listed in runs/formal/schedule.json (matched on the scheduled call identity); explicit provider refusals are recorded but are not papers
